newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina says IMF gives initial OK for loan talks.
newsitem.headline: Argentina says IMF gives initial OK for loan talks.

text.p: Argentina is eligible for an IMF Extended Fund Facility loan and talks for a three-year EFF will start shortly, the Economy Ministry quoted Finance Secretary Pablo Guidotti as saying Tuesday in Washington.
Guidotti, who is taking part in a meeting of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank, said IMF officials told him Argentina "meets the criteria to request an EFF."
He said the officials agreed on an outline for negotiations on the loan.
The ministry also said an IMF team will visit Argentina between May 5-16 to review compliance with first-quarter fiscal targets.
